name: Gauradas
bio: Gauradas is one of the named epigrammatists of the Greek Anthology. Paton’s Index of Authors gives no date for him.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fifth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XVI: 152.

poems.title: Book XVI, 152
poems.author: Gauradas
poems.text: Dear Echo, grant me somewhat.—What? I love a girl, but do not think she loves.—She loves. But to do it Time gives me not good chance.—Good chance. Do thou then tell her I love her, if so be thy will.—I will. And here is a pledge in the shape of cash I beg thee to hand over.—Hand over. Echo, what remains but to succeed?—Succeed.
